overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's answers to students at the May 18 assembly were not deliberation, so the event was not a meeting requiring notice or recording announcement.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged all three selectmen answered students' questions at an elementary school assembly on May 18 without posting notice for a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing a video recording of the May 18 assembly, we find that in answering the students’ questions, the Board did not deliberate.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to announce that the May 18 student assembly was being recorded.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board did not deliberate during the May 18 assembly, the assembly was not a meeting for purposes of the Open Meeting Law and the Board was not required to post notice or announce that the assembly was being recorded.
